stories.title: Navi Mumbai Crime News 6 Arrested For Posing As FDA Officials, Extorting ₹2.66 Lakh From Vashi Trader After Fake Gutkha Raid
stories.summary: NaveShahar Navi Mumbai: The APMC police have arrested six persons for allegedly posing as Food and Drug Administration (FDA) officials and extorting money from pan shop owners and grocery traders by threatening them with raids and legal action over the sale of gutkha.

stories.title: After 15-year delay, BMC clears 27 structures for road widening in Kandivali
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Tuesday demolished 27 structures that had been obstructing a long-pending road-widening project at the Mathuradas Road-Swami Vivekanand Road junction in Kandivali West. The demolition drive was carried out by the civic body's R-South Ward under its 'Pedestrian First' campaign, which aims to make footpaths more accessible to pedestrians by removing encroachments and clearing roads.

stories.title: Mumbai: Newborns at BMC hospitals to get birth certificates within three days
stories.summary: Newborns delivered at Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)-run hospitals will now receive their birth certificates within three days of registration, bringing relief to parents who earlier had to visit civic administrative offices to complete the process. BMC officials on Tuesday, November 17, announced that the birth certificates would be issued directly at the hospitals where the children are born.

stories.title: Mumbai’s First Underground Toilet-Cum-Art Gallery Planned at Kala Ghoda; BMC Approves ₹24-Crore Project
stories.summary: In a move to improve pedestrian movement and preserve the heritage character of South Mumbai, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ( BMC ) has given in-principle approval to develop an underground public facility near Lion Gate in Kala Ghoda. Estimated to cost ₹24 crore, the proposed project will replace the existing Aspirational Toilet and Solid Waste Management (SWM) department chowkies with a 1,668-square-metre underground complex.

stories.title: Mumbai car dealer's trade certificate suspended over Ferrari delivery
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Transport Department has suspended the trade certificate of a Mumbai-based car dealer for 30 days for allegedly handing over a Ferrari to a customer before completing the vehicle’s registration, officials said on Wednesday. According to the Transport Commissioner’s office, a Navnit Motors outlet in Bandra delivered a red Ferrari to its owner on October 13, before completing its registration formalities, in violation of prescribed rules.

stories.title: Mumbai: Shiv Sena (UBT) Protests Outside Mayor's Office After Shaina NC Accidentally Tears Balasaheb Thackeray's Photo At Press Meet | VIDEO
stories.summary: VIDEO | X Mumbai: Shiv Sena (UBT) corporators and party workers on Wednesday staged a protest outside Mumbai Mayor Ritu Tawde's office after Shaina NC, a leader of the Shiv Sena group led by Eknath Shinde, was seen accidentally tearing a photograph of party founder Balasaheb Thackeray during a press conference.

stories.title: 53 year old man stabbed in local train, accused arrested
stories.summary: An elderly passenger was allegedly stabbed inside a Virar-Churchgate fast local, leaving him injured near Andheri railway station. The incident took place on November 15, when train was heading to Churchgate, near Andheri station, the accused threw knife on fellow passenger, identified as Suresh Sharma (53), a resident of Dharavi’s Sion area.

stories.title: Mumbai: Five bikers arrested for performing dangerous stunts on WEH
stories.summary: Mumbai Police have arrested five bikers for allegedly performing dangerous stunts, driving recklessly and creating a public nuisance on the Western Express Highway (WEH) . As per the officials, the action was taken after a video highlighting the bikers' activities circulated on social media, prompting the police to take cognisance of the incident.

stories.title: Kate Middleton looks radiant in cherry red skirt suit with Prince William for visit to Mumbai craft school and maternity hospital
stories.summary: The Prince and Princes of Wales, Prince William and Kate Middleton , are on a three-day visit to India. After attending the star-studded Earthshot Prize Awards 2026 in Mumbai last night, Prince William visited filmmaker Karan Johar's Dharma Productions office in Mumbai, followed by a joint visit with Kate Middleton to the Chanakya School of Craft and Nowrosjee Wadia Maternity Hospital.

stories.title: Missing three-year-old boy found dead in Andheri drain after three-day search
stories.summary: The body of a three-year-old boy, who had gone missing from the DN Nagar area on November 14, was found floating in a drain in Andheri West on Tuesday, bringing a tragic end to the search for the child. Preliminary investigations suggest that he may have accidentally fallen into the drain and drowned.

stories.title: Man arrested for allegedly killing acquaintance over unpaid mobile loan
stories.summary: A man allegedly killed his 23-year-old acquaintance following a dispute over unpaid mobile loan instalments and dumped the body in bushes at a village in Navi Mumbai, police said on Wednesday. Officials said that the incident occurred last week. They also added that the accused, identified as Pratik Mohan Jadhav (30), a resident of Panvel in Navi Mumbai, was arrested on Monday, as per PTI.

stories.title: Dawood Ibrahims Ancestral Home In Mumbais Bhendi Bazaar To Be Demolished By BMC | Video
stories.summary: Mumbai: A building in south Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar, identified as the ancestral home of fugitive underworld figure Dawood Ibrahim, was partially demolished by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Wednesday. Visuals from the site showed the structure being pulled down, with debris scattered across the premises as residents gathered to witness the demolition.

stories.title: Shivaji Maharaj’s Historic Vagh Nakh Goes on Display at Mumbai Museum
stories.summary: Mumbaikars can now witness the historic Vagh Nakh (tiger claw weapon) associated with Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and his legendary encounter with Afzal Khan in 1659. The centuries-old weapon has gone on public display at the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (CSMVS) in South Mumbai as part of a special exhibition titled ‘Shivshastra Shauryagatha’.

stories.title: Kate Middleton debuts late Queen Elizabeth's sparkling emerald-diamond necklace for Earthshot Prize with Prince William in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales, Prince William and Kate Middleton, attended the sixth annual Earthshot Prize awards ceremony in Mumbai. The royal couple is in India to attend the Earthshot Prize events and meet young environmental innovators from across the world. For the awards ceremony in Mumbai, Prince William traded the tuxedo for a black Manish Malhotra bandhgala.

stories.title: Mumbai: Man arrested for demanding Rs 1 lakh from Nanded businessman
stories.summary: Police in Maharashtra's Nanded have arrested a man in Mumbai for allegedly demanding Rs 1 lakh from a businessman. Officials said that the accused threatened the victim with a claim that he had previously plotted to kill a former Maharashtra Chief Minister and four MLAs from the district, as per PTI.

stories.title: IndiGo aircraft grounded after bird hit at Navi Mumbai airport
stories.summary: An IndiGo flight from Mangaluru reported a bird hit on arrival at Navi Mumbai International Airport on Tuesday, following which the aircraft was grounded for inspection, a PTI source said. The bird struck the right side of the aircraft's fuselage, and the plane was taken out of service pending necessary checks, the source said.

stories.title: BMC signs MoU with Dutch non-profit to tackle plastic pollution in Mumbai rivers
stories.summary: In a move to tackle plastic pollution in Mumbai's waterways, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Netherlands-based non-profit organisation The Ocean Cleanup to expand waste interception operations across the city. The agreement signed between The Ocean Cleanup and the BMC will also facilitate nine additional permits for deploying the organisation's Interceptor systems in Mumbai's waterways.

stories.title: Rajkumar Wankhede takes charge as Additional General Manager of Central Railway
stories.summary: Rajkumar Wankhede has taken charge as the Additional General Manager of Central Railway , bringing more than 36 years of experience in railway infrastructure, construction and project management. Wankhede is an officer of the 1990 batch of the Indian Railway Service of Engineers (IRSE). Before his appointment to Central Railway, he was serving as Additional General Manager of North Central Railway.

stories.title: Man hit by knife thrown during fight on local train
stories.summary: A 53-year-old man was injured after a knife thrown during a fight between two passengers on a local train struck him in the chest on Sunday, the latest among several violent incidents this year that have drawn attention to commuter safety on the suburban rail network.

stories.title: Torres Jewellery fraud: Ukrainian national Oleksandr Zapichenko extradited from Romania
stories.summary: Ukrainian national Oleksandr Zapichenko, 38, an accused in the Torres Jewellery fraud case, has been extradited to India, where he will stand trial for defrauding thousands of investors in Mumbai. Zapichenko was arrested in Romania based on an Interpol Red Corner Notice against him and was escorted to Mumbai by a team from the Enforcement Directorate (ED) investigating the money laundering aspect of the case.

stories.title: Mumbai Crime: 31-Year-Old Man Arrested For Allegedly Groping 39-Year-Old Law Student On Asalfa Road, Caught
stories.summary: According to police, the incident occurred at approximately 2:20 pm when the victim, a homemaker and first-year law student at a Juhu college, was returning home after purchasing spices from a neighbourhood shop in Asalfa Village near Dhobighat. In her complaint, she stated that an unknown person standing on the road groped her as she walked past him before fleeing quickly from the spot.

stories.title: Prince William and Princess Catherine visit India, in photos
stories.summary: Prince William’s visit to Mumbai on Monday brought traffic movement across several parts of South Mumbai to a crawl, with motorists facing congestion on major arterial roads as the Mumbai Traffic Police diverted vehicles and temporarily stopped traffic to facilitate the movement of the royal entourage.

stories.title: Mumbai: SGNP to remain closed to morning walkers on November 18
stories.summary: Sanjay Gandhi National Park (SGNP) in Borivali will remain closed to morning walkers on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, due to a scheduled protest march (morcha) at the park. An official statement from the SGNP authorities issued an important notice informing morning walkers about the temporary closure and requested them to avoid visiting the premises on the day of the protest.

stories.title: HC tells BMC to take measures to prevent dog bites in Kandivali society
stories.summary: More than 50 dog bites in a year, and the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) caught two dogs and then released back where they were found: this is what residents of a Kandivali housing society told the Bombay High Court, which has now directed the civic body to take effective measures to stop the attacks and file an affidavit by December 1 detailing the steps taken.

stories.title: Mumbai Railway accident survivor gets second chance as doctors save severed foot
stories.summary: I will bounce back soon and start afresh.” These are the determined words of 30-year-old Ronak Bhuptani, a chartered accountant (CA) who survived a devastating railway accident that completely severed his left foot above the ankle. Though two hospitals initially ruled out reattachment, a surgical team at Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital successfully saved his limb through a complex microsurgical procedure.

stories.title: NASA's Voyager 1 space probe is now one light-day away from Earth
stories.summary: It traveled more than 49 years to get to this point, and its journey isn’t done yet. stories.title: A yr after picking up gun: Kashmir’s last known active LeT terrorist meets his end
stories.summary: On November 18, 2025, Mohammad Lateef Bhat joined Lashkar-e-Taiba, according to police. Exactly a year later, he was killed in a gunfight in his home district of Kulgam. In between, the ‘A-category’ terrorist had become one of Kashmir’s most wanted, with a Rs 15 lakh bounty on his head.

stories.title: Fresh encounter erupts in Kulgam as security forces hunt terrorists behind CRPF attack
stories.summary: A fresh encounter broke out in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kulgam district as security forces continued operations against terrorists linked to last week’s attack on a CRPF post. The renewed exchange of fire comes days after security forces killed Umar Nisar Dar, an accused in the attack that injured three CRPF personnel.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh: YS Sharmila Faces YSRCP Attack Over Wedding Invite To CM Chandrababu Naidu
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh Congress chief YS Sharmila has faced criticism from the YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) over her decision to invite Chief Minister and Telugu Desam Party (TDP) chief Chandrababu Naidu to her daughter's wedding, with party leaders alleging that her gesture goes against the political legacy of her father, YS Rajasekhara Reddy.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI has arrived
stories.summary: Part of this has to do with the success of its predecessor, as GTA V sold more than 230 million copies over the last 13 years. stories.title: Delhi Police Tells Supreme Court Social Media Reel-Makers Cannot Claim Same Protections As Journalists During Protests
stories.summary: Maratha__Newz The Delhi Police has told the Supreme Court that social media influencers, reel-makers and content creators cannot automatically claim the same protection granted to journalists covering protests. While individuals have the right to gather and report news, they must comply with the law and police directions, it said.

stories.title: Mission Mirchi: Technician dies in truck crash
stories.summary: Filming of 'Mission Mirchi', featuring Vijay Varma and Jaideep Ahlawat, has reportedly come to a halt after tragedy struck the team in Sikkim. 'Mission Mirchi' technician identified as Pintu MondalAccording to a PTI report, the accident occurred close to the 5th Mile stretch of Jawaharlal Nehru Road. The technician who died has been identified as Pintu Mondal, a light boy employed with the Kolkata-based agency Light & Light.

stories.title: Shinde-Led Shiv Sena Seeks Ban On Sonia Gandhi Memoir Over Savarkar Remarks, Tears Book Pages In Protest
stories.summary: Shiv Sena leaders tore pages of Sonia Gandhi's memoir on Wednesday, objecting to the reference to VD Savarkar. | Screenshot via Shiv Sena/X Mumbai: The Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena on Wednesday demanded a ban on Congress leader Sonia Gandhi's memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love , in Maharashtra, objecting to references in the book to freedom fighter Vinayak Damodar Savarkar.

stories.title: Delhi Court orders framing of charges against 14 accused in NEET-UG paper leak case
stories.summary: A Delhi fast-track court on Wednesday ordered the framing of charges against 14 people accused in the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak case. The CBI alleged that three National Testing Agency (NTA)-contracted subject experts stole confidential examination questions and passed them on to a network of middlemen and coaching operators for monetary gain.

stories.title: ‘Heavens Won’t Fall’: Supreme Court Refuses To Stay Azam Khan’s Interim Bail, To Hear ED’s Plea On Thursday
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Wednesday refused to stay the interim bail granted to senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan in a money laundering case. The court said there was no need for immediate intervention and allowed Khan to remain on interim bail.

stories.title: Supreme Court issues notice on contempt plea against lawyer over remarks about CJI
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Wednesday issued notice on a contempt petition against a lawyer who made alleged defamatory and objectionable comments against Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant.

stories.title: Maharashtra declares four more talukas drought-hit; total count rises to 308
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has declared four more talukas drought-hit following deficient rainfall, taking the total number of affected talukas to 308 out of the state's 358. The decision was taken on Tuesday at a meeting of the state cabinet's drought relief sub-committee at Mantralaya, chaired by Revenue Minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule.

stories.title: SpiceJet board approves raising up to ₹5,500 crore
stories.summary: SpiceJet’s board on Wednesday approved a proposal to raise up to ₹ 5,500 crore, as the cash-strapped airline looks to strengthen its financial position, rebuild capacity and support its revival plans. The company said it could raise the money by issuing fresh shares or through other financial instruments, including debt and convertible securities.

stories.title: Air India crash: Centre says investigation at 'fag end'; report still awaited
stories.summary: The investigation into the June 2025 Air India crash that killed 260 people is in its final stages, the Centre told the Supreme Court on Wednesday. “We are at the fag end of the investigation,” Solicitor General Tushar Mehta told a bench led by the Chief Justice of India.

stories.title: Upasana Singh Recalls Crew Deaths On Set, Says Shoots Continued Uninterrupted
stories.summary: Actor Upasana Singh has questioned the lack of humanity in the entertainment industry during a recent conversation with Ankur Singh on his YouTube channel. Recalling a disturbing incident from her time as a judge on a comedy reality show, she spoke about how the race for TRPs can sometimes take precedence over people's well-being.

stories.title: William and Kate to meet Indian Prime Minister Modi in New Delhi
stories.summary: William and Catherine arrived in New Dehli on Wednesday for the final leg of their first official oversees trip together in four years. The meeting was a late addition to the couple's schedule and came after Modi confirmed he would be back from a scheduled trip to the Philippines in time to see the royals.

stories.title: SC notice to Lokpal on plea against HC verdict saying hearing not needed before show-cause notice
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) sought a response from the Lokpal of India on a plea challenging a Delhi High Court verdict which held that the anti-corruption ombudsman was not required to provide a public servant an opportunity of hearing before issuing a show-cause notice with regard to an investigation.

stories.title: Delhi Court Seeks Police Report On Complaint Against Sonia Gandhi Over Alleged Irregularities In 1980 Voter Roll Entry
stories.summary: File A Delhi court on Wednesday sought an action taken report (ATR) from Delhi Police on a complaint alleging that Congress leader Sonia Gandhi’s name was included in the electoral roll in 1980, nearly three years before she acquired Indian citizenship.

stories.title: Nashik: Rice Prices Likely To Rise As Poor Rainfall Hits Paddy Crop In Three Talukas
stories.summary: FP photo |Representative Nashik: Insufficient rainfall has caused significant damage to paddy crops in Igatpuri, Peth and Trimbakeshwar talukas of Nashik district. Farmers in Igatpuri, a region traditionally known as a hub for paddy cultivation, are deeply concerned about the prospect of a poor harvest.

stories.title: Indore Labourer Dies After Falling From 4th Floor Of Under-Construction Building
stories.summary: Indore (Madhya Pradesh): A 34-year-old labourer died after falling from the fourth floor of an under-construction building in Madhya Pradesh's Indore, police said on Wednesday. The accident occurred when the labourer lost his balance while removing wooden planks (shuttering) after completing plastering work.

stories.title: After a 13-year wait, Grand Theft Auto VI arrives with enormous hype and expectations
stories.summary: LOS ANGELES (AP) — After a 13-year wait, one of entertainment’s biggest releases is finally here. “Grand Theft Auto VI” launches Thursday, sending players back to Vice City and testing whether Rockstar Games can follow one of the bestselling video games ever made with another cultural and commercial phenomenon.

stories.title: SC Issues Notices To Congress, AAP, CJP, AISA Over Protests Against CEC
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Wednesday issued notices to organisations involved in protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar last month, including the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), Indian National Congress (INC), Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) and All India Students Association (AISA). stories.title: Mortal remains of Keralite killed in flash flood in Malaysia to be brought home on November 19
stories.summary: The body of Raghunath Manikoth, 48, a native of Thalassery in Kannur district, who was among three Keralites killed in a flash flood in the Pertak river at Kuala Kubu Bharu in Malaysia, will be brought home on Thursday (November 19). m. on Wednesday (November 18). From the airport, the mortal remains will be transported to his hometown in a dedicated NoRKA ambulance on Thursday morning.

stories.title: Wanted LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat killed in Kulgam, ending 8-day anti-terror operation
stories.summary: Security forces have killed wanted Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist Lateef Bhat in south Kashmir’s Kulgam district, ending an eight-day operation linked to the November 11 attack on CRPF personnel. Officials said Bhat, a key accused in the attack that injured three CRPF personnel, was tracked down after an intensive manhunt.

stories.title: Army captain killed, three personnel injured as vehicle falls into Itam river in Manipur
stories.summary: A 29-year-old Army captain was killed and three other personnel were injured after a vehicle carrying personnel of the 8th Bihar Regiment fell into the Itam river in Manipur’s Imphal East district on Wednesday, police said. The accident occurred at around 2 pm at Lamlai Challou. The injured personnel were taken to BABINA Hospital, where Captain Hanuman Ram died during treatment.

stories.title: GRAP-3 lifted as Delhi air improves, but Gurugram AQI worsens | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: Gurugram’s air quality deteriorated on Tuesday, with the air quality index (AQI) rising 43 points to 290, even as the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) revoked Stage 3 restrictions under the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) across Delhi-NCR following an improvement in Delhi’s pollution levels. Delhi recorded an AQI of 204, also in the ‘poor’ category, while one of Gurugram’s four monitoring stations registered ‘very poor’ air quality.

stories.title: Nashik: Two Youths Killed In Head-On Motorcycle Collision Near Mahindra Sona In Satpur
stories.summary: Two youths were killed in a head-on collision between two motorcycles near the Mahindra Sona company in the Satpur Industrial Estate on Tuesday, Nov 17, around 7 am. Rajesh Krishna Bhoye, 25, a resident of Nishan Khadak in Peth taluka, died on the spot, while Dhananjay Samadhan Pagar, 21, a resident of Shivajinagar on Gangapur Road in Satpur, succumbed to his injuries during treatment.

stories.title: Lighter Temporarily Blocks Withdrawals After Suspected $15.5 Million Crypto Attack
stories.summary: Decentralised perpetual futures exchange Lighter has suspended withdrawals and liquidity pool creation following a suspected security incident involving two market maker accounts. 48 million in USDC, with the attacker allegedly exploiting account permissions to move funds through a newly created liquidity pool. Lighter said it was investigating the incident and had taken precautionary measures.

stories.title: Sharad Kapoor Hadn't Bathed Or Gotten Out Of Bed For 2 Years, Was 'Gradually Dying', Claims Friend
stories.summary: Actor Sharad Kapoor was reportedly in an extremely poor condition when his friend Hema Chaudhary first found him earlier this month. Making a shocking revelation about his health and living circumstances, Chaudhary claimed that the actor had not bathed or even got out of bed for nearly two years.

stories.title: 'I Became The Scapegoat': Cameron Bancroft Alleges Entire Australian Team Knew About 2018 Sandpaper Ball-Tampering Scandal But Left Him To Take The Blame
stories.summary: Cameron Bancroft, the former Australian opener caught applying sandpaper to the ball during the 2018 tour of South Africa, has alleged that the entire team was aware of the ball-tampering operation, claiming he ultimately became the “scapegoat” for an incident that went beyond the three players initially punished.

stories.title: Pakistani man gets 27 years in US prison for Iran-backed plot to assassinate Trump
stories.summary: Asif Merchant was found guilty in March of attempting to commit an act of terrorism transcending national boundaries and murder for hire after trying to hire hitmen to kill Trump, former President Joe Biden, and former US ambassador to the United Nations Nikki Haley.

stories.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
stories.summary: Kuwait and Bahrain have said they repelled Iranian air attacks overnight as hostilities between Iran and the United States rise. The drone attack on Kuwait was the first in more than two months. The Iranian army said it had targeted the Ali Al Salem Airbase, which hosts US forces, but Kuwaiti authorities did not report any damage.

stories.title: Russian military transport plane crashes in Siberia, killing 19: Defence Ministry
stories.summary: A Russian military transport plane crashed in western Siberia on Tuesday (November 17, 2026), killing all 19 people on board, the Defence Ministry said. Preliminary findings pointed to equipment failure. The An-12 aircraft went down in an unpopulated area near the city of Kemerovo, about 3,000 kilometres (about 1,860 miles) east of Moscow.

stories.title: Xi, Putin meet ahead of historic Trump trilateral summit
stories.summary: Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin began talks in Shenzhen on Wednesday (November 18, 2026), a day ahead of a historic three-way summit with Donald Trump in the southern Chinese city. stories.title: Why Ukraine keeps targeting the Kerch Bridge
stories.summary: In 2022, Ukraine bombed the Kerch bridge linking mainland Russia to the Crimean Peninsula, using explosives hidden in a truck. In 2023, naval drones struck the bridge. In 2025, covert Ukrainian operatives planted bombs on its undersea support pillars. But none of these attacks caused major damage to the structure, which Russian President Vladimir Putin described in 2018 as a “miracle”.

stories.summary: The Israeli Parliament elected a new speaker on Tuesday (November 18, 2026), a key step toward rolling back policies passed by the outgoing government led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. stories.title: Bomb blasts, arson rock Bangladesh ahead of Hasina's planned return
stories.summary: Hasina, 79, has been living in exile in neighbouring India since fleeing Dhaka in August 2024 following violent protests demanding her resignation. She has requested a new passport and identity card, saying she plans to return to Bangladesh in December.

stories.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) attacked the Bharatiya Janata Party -led (BJP) Centre over the denial of Statehood to Jammu and Kashmir and wondered whether the party was deliberately deferring it till gets its own Chief Minister in the Union Territory.

stories.summary: 40 crore contract with Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) for the upgradation and obsolescence management of the Barak point defence missile system deployed on board Indian Navy warships. stories.title: Who to watch in Spain's election race
stories.summary: Spanish voters face a snap election on 29 November, with the conservatives and the far right favourites to win after eight years of Socialist-led rule under Pedro Sánchez.
